areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Health-sector spending-rationalization component with indicators, but focus is internal efficiency, so little impact on public health access (about a quarter of resources).

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Pension audit system improves financial sustainability but is unrelated to extending coverage to all forms of work; very small resource share.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: One of the most affected areas: several objectives, a dedicated component with about a third of resources and many indicators; moderate impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: System modernization aimed at internal management rather than citizens; small resource share and few digital-transformation indicators; limited impact.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Core pillar: systems and audits to save resources, about 30% of funds and several savings indicators; moderate impact.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No components, products or indicators related to the area; sub-products added in the resubmission have no funds and were not deemed achievable.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Transparency is a cross-cutting aim, but no specific objectives, products or indicators allow assessing results.

not_accepted.name: Sustainable cities
not_accepted.reason: No components, products or indicators related to the area; sub-products added in the resubmission have no funds and were not deemed achievable.

not_accepted.name: Transparency and participation
not_accepted.reason: Transparency is a cross-cutting aim, but no specific objectives, products or indicators allow assessing results.
